data.title: 欧根亲王 · 海景阳台的微风索求
data.description: 度假套房海景阳台被夜色与海风笼罩，比基尼挂脖细带已被解开。欧根后背轻靠着玻璃栏杆仰头承受深吻，红挑染在夜风中飘舞，海浪轰鸣掩盖着炽热滚烫的娇喘。
data.location: luxurious oceanfront suite balcony under moonlight and crashing waves
data.action: pinned gently against private resort balcony glass railing, bikini halter neck strings untied, head tilted back in ecstasy during deep kiss, red hair streak whipped by sea breeze
data.lighting: cool silver moonlight reflecting off the ocean waters below
data.mood: passionate abandon, summer night heat, breathless romantic indulgence
data.promptProse: Backed against a resort balcony railing in moonlight with her bikini strings undone, Prinz Eugen shares a deep breathless kiss in the sea breeze.
data.animaCaption: Prinz Eugen in an untied bikini sharing a deep passionate kiss on an ocean balcony.
